description: flakeyard atom repositories: default rules; consumers follow every input, so no update releases, except lib-atom, which the atom pins itself

packageRules.description: Updates of lib-atom are fix, so that they are released: the atom pins it in its root flake.lock and a release of the atom delivers it to projects; its dev flake takes that pin; the rule follows the other commit types of the presets to win over them (FY-0040)
